note: Before and after for the 0.514.0 change notes and the mod page, chosen to show this release's newest work (layout version 9, the rebuilt props and the new creatures). Built by tools/shotbot/showcase.py. Before is the released 0.513.3 (bin/backroomsss_0.513.3.zip) in a world it made (rel0513, layout version 7); after is the 0.514.0 build in a world it made (gfxgallery9, layout version 9; the hotel lobby, Kitty's room, the bedroom and Level !'s junk retaken in gfxgallery9c from a build of 3ef62b0, after the piano's chair, the bigger bedroom, the brighter downlights and the evenly spaced EXIT signs); all at the review seed 1672613597, the same spots (review/shots514/spots/pairs-old.json and pairs-new.json, review/shots514c/spots/; Kitty's room lies four rows further south from 3ef62b0, so its spot moved with it; Level !'s hall is shorter in layout 9, so its spot stands the same distance before each world's real exit). The creature lineup's before is the 0.513 gallery's (review/b18/gallery-old). review/ is git-ignored and exists only on the machine that shot it.

pairs.subject: Level 11: a hotel lobby
pairs.caption: Ground floors are laid out by kind of building: a hotel lobby gets its front desk facing the door, sitting areas and a grand piano, now rebuilt with keys, a raised lid and pedals, and standing with its own bench.

pairs.subject: Level 11: street furniture
pairs.caption: The mailbox, fire hydrant and streetlights are rebuilt with real parts in the same places, the sidewalk and asphalt are the new materials, and behind the glass the lobby is furnished as a hotel's.

pairs.subject: Level 94: fences and the STOP sign
pairs.caption: Picket fences stand back from the road behind a grass verge, joined round the bends, with gates and openings; the STOP sign is a proper octagonal plate on a galvanised post.

pairs.subject: The Hub: a side tunnel
pairs.caption: The tunnels are rounded like the road tunnels in the pictures, the walls curving into a vault, the lamps at the top of the wall, a white edge line on the road and a rounded kerb.

pairs.subject: Level 974: Kitty's room
pairs.caption: The master bedroom with the cat bed is nearly twice as big (6 by 7 blocks, it was 6 by 4), with a second window, three lights and a doorway Kitty can walk through upright (before by the shotbot's daylight, after by the room's own lights).

pairs.subject: Level 974: the bedroom where you wake
pairs.caption: The bedroom with the twin bed, the desk and the open closet is much longer (6 by 10 blocks, it was 6 by 6), with a second window and a second light; the closet stands at its far end. Both by the house's own lights.

pairs.subject: Level !: the junk on the floor
pairs.caption: Flat litter became bulky junk you can see coming: loops of orange extension cord, a wheelchair, dumped boxes and a barricade of chairs; overhead, the hanging EXIT signs run in a steady line about twelve blocks apart instead of in clusters (shot with a held lantern).

pairs.subject: The Snackrooms: the vending room's doorway
pairs.caption: The machine blocking a vending room's doorway is a broken one, cracked glass, a dented panel and a dead display, that can be broken up for its snacks.

pairs.subject: Level 9: a two-storey house
pairs.caption: Houses get windows two blocks tall with sashes, casings and sills, shutters on the front, a picture window and a panelled front door that opens (shot by the shotbot's daylight).

pairs.subject: What lives here
pairs.caption: Every creature repainted, the Bacteria rebuilt as a tangle of black wire, and three new ones: the Beast of Level 5 (as the gentleman), the Giant Spider and the Neighborhood Watch.
